# Copilot Instructions for 30-DAYS-FSD

## Project Overview
This repository appears to be a collection of daily front-end development exercises or demos. The current files suggest a focus on HTML and CSS, with assets for styling and branding.

## Key Files
- `DAY6.HTML`: Main HTML file for Day 6's exercise or demo.
- `DAY6.CSS`: Associated stylesheet for Day 6.
- `logo1.png`, `_login_background.jpg`: Image assets used in the HTML/CSS.

## Patterns & Conventions
- All files for a given day are named with the pattern `DAY{N}.HTML` and `DAY{N}.CSS`.
- Images are referenced directly in HTML/CSS, stored at the project root.
- No build tools, frameworks, or package managers are present; this is a static project.
- No README or documentation files exist yet.

## Developer Workflow
- Open the HTML file in a browser to view the result.
- Edit the corresponding CSS file for styling changes.
- Add new days by duplicating the file naming pattern.
- No build, test, or deployment scripts are present or required.

## AI Agent Guidance
- Maintain the file naming convention for new days.
- Keep all assets (images, CSS, HTML) at the project root unless a new structure is introduced.
- Avoid introducing frameworks or build tools unless explicitly requested.
- If adding documentation, create a `README.md` at the project root.
- If introducing new conventions, document them here.

## Example: Adding Day 7
- Create `DAY7.HTML` and `DAY7.CSS` at the root.
- Reference any new images directly at the root.
- Link `DAY7.CSS` in `DAY7.HTML` as done in previous days.
